digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criteria routing and divergence grading
propositions: G7 routing entry currently has default_posture 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95, preventing plan-review blocking despite 22/29 correct historical findings at priority >= 0.85 with zero clearly-incorrect findings across 348 historical G7 findings

Unresolvable parent tickets are emitted as findings instead of abstaining with coverage, and duplicate findings for the same contradicted parent clause stack rather than consolidating into one finding with combined evidence

Plan-review blocking must scope to floor-grade kinds (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site) which hard-floor impact at 0.85, while incomplete_enumeration contributes only 0.55 and cannot block via the divergence axis

The fix requires routing flip (default_posture 'advisory' to 'blocking', block_threshold 0.95 to 0.85) plus rubric guidance for abstain-on-unresolvable, closed-parent final-state checking, one-finding-per-clause dedup, and floor-kind scoping, with no changes to pass3_decide kernel machinery
